units.title: Create the synthetic fixture contract and owner-registered policy profile
units.instructions:
Assigned boundary only: - [ ] T001 [P] Create synthetic Plan, Claim, policy, validator, execution, artifact, and exact subject reference builders in `src/analytics/acceptance/010.test.ts`.

- [ ] T002 [P] Implement strict owner-registered immutable policy profiles, method/scope applicability, required validator descriptors, permitted `not_applicable` reasons, claim rule, authority route, schema validation, and policy-fixture gate in `src/analytics/policies.ts`.

**Checkpoint**: The current policy reference comes only from the configured owner registration route; worker proposals cannot publish or alter required validators.
Preserve frozen interfaces and all accepted requirements. Consume completed upstream APIs; do not implement future checklist tasks or repair unrelated production boundaries. Add top-level behavioral tests named scope:010-policy-foundation: <behavior> with a valid control and each assigned rejection/recovery case. Targeted tests must execute and pass, not merely compile or select zero tests. Test-first fixtures for this unit must become passing through this unit's implementation; future assertions are owned by later units. Review only this boundary and its actual caller; retain whole-feature integration for the final unit.
